record.original_question: If A is any analytic subset of the Riemann sphere it was shown by Kierst [474] that A is (exactly) the set of asymptotic values of a function meromorphic in D. If ∞ ∈ A, Kierst also proved that A is the set of asymptotic values of a function f analytic in D. However, there exist analytic sets which are not the set of asymptotic values of a function analytic in D. Ryan [691] has characterised those subsets of the Riemann sphere which are the set of asymptotic values of a function analytic in D. Can one find a simpler characterisation? (K. F. Barth)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$ be the open unit disc, and let $\widehat{\mathbb{C}} = \mathbb{C} \cup \{\infty\}$ denote the Riemann sphere. For a function $f$ defined on $D$, a point $\alpha \in \widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ is called an asymptotic value of $f$ if there exists a continuous curve $\gamma:[0,1) \to D$ with $|\gamma(t)| \to 1$ as $t \to 1^-$ such that $f(\gamma(t)) \to \alpha$ as $t \to 1^-$. Denote by $\mathrm{As}(f) \subseteq \widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ the set of all asymptotic values of $f$.

It is known that:
(i) A subset $A \subseteq \widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ is the asymptotic value set of some meromorphic function on $D$ if and only if $A$ is an analytic set (a continuous image of a Polish space) in $\widehat{\mathbb{C}}$.
(ii) If $A$ is an analytic subset of $\widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ with $\infty \in A$, then $A = \mathrm{As}(f)$ for some function $f$ holomorphic on $D$.
(iii) There exist analytic subsets of $\widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ which are not the asymptotic value set of any function holomorphic on $D$, and a (rather involved) characterization of those subsets of $\widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ which do arise as $\mathrm{As}(f)$ for some holomorphic $f$ on $D$ has been given.

Problem: Find a simpler characterization of the subsets $A \subseteq \widehat{\mathbb{C}}$ which can be realized as the set of asymptotic values $\mathrm{As}(f)$ of some function $f$ holomorphic on the unit disc $D$.
artifact.status_search_result: Ryan's 1965/1966 characterization (published in Duke Math. J.) of the asymptotic value sets of holomorphic functions on the unit disc is the known reference. No subsequent paper found in the search appears to provide a substantially simpler characterization, but this could not be conclusively verified from available sources.
